title: Show portrait wallpaper twins on portrait screens
head: 0b551cdc995a
workflow: Opus full review, Sol boundary hunter, Opus self-check of the draft, editorial check, batch gates

leads.summary: Snapshot paths cannot find portrait twins during a theme transition
leads.consequence: For a normal still-to-still theme switch, theme-set snapshots the selected original at ~/.cache/omarchy/background-transitions/next-<pid>.<ext> and passes that path to themeTransition. On a portrait output incomingFrame requests .../background-transitions/portrait/next-<pid>.<ext>, which theme-set never creates. Its Image.Error is not handled, maybeStartReveal requires Image.Ready and the transition stays unrevealed even if the new theme has a proper backgrounds/portrait/<name> twin; colors still apply via the 300ms fallback timer. An equivalent missing twin for bg-next/image picker also stalls the transition. Resolve portrait sources from the canonical theme selection, not solely the snapshot basename, and handle Image.Error for incoming/old frames.

leads.summary: A missing portrait video never reaches the new fallback hook
leads.consequence: On a portrait monitor with a selected .mp4/.webm etc lacking a twin, oriented() points the player to a nonexistent portrait video; BackgroundVideo.qml does not define a failed property and the MediaPlayer's error is never forwarded, so failed stays false and orientFailedFor is never set. A normal theme's video only exists at its top level (and the picker and theme-set select that top-level file), hence that monitor loses video instead of falling back to the selected clip. Under current quattro, OWE owns videos and this per-screen loader no longer runs.

leads.summary: Current quattro no longer has the rendering or decode interfaces this patch expects
leads.consequence: The pinned branch tip diverged across both files: merge-file produces 4 conflict blocks in Background.qml and 1 in BackgroundMedia.qml. Quattro replaces per-screen video playback with OWE, removes BackgroundMedia.reloads/playbackEnabled/audioEnabled and adds constrainDecode/decodeSize; it probes nativeSizes indexed by the canonical path. Simply retaining the head-side portrait source after resolving text conflicts either binds removed properties or requests decoded portrait paths whose sizes were never probed; retaining the tip-side source omits the portrait feature entirely. Rebase the feature and rework portrait probes, image sizes, and OWE/lock consumers rather than just resolving conflict markers.

leads.summary: Related open per-screen background PRs use incompatible paths and conflict in the same render slots
leads.consequence: Open #11451 (CONFLICTING, divergent) provides backgrounds/<basename>/portrait.png variants and selects from image dimensions; merging its exact head against this head using their common file ancestor produces 3 conflicts in Background.qml, including base.path, oldFrame and incomingFrame. #9312 (CONFLICTING, divergent) provides same-stem aspect-ratio variants with a different resolver; #9313 builds on #9312, not an independent conflicting third PR. Their base.path and media image component also conflict (5 and 2 conflict blocks with #9312). These cannot be stacked by just keeping both assignments: one selects a variant and the other rewrites its selected path to /portrait/<filename>, and one PR replaces oldFrame with a captured output. Coordinate one variant contract and tests if either implementation lands first.
leads.triage: already in Opus final (F3 related PRs); hunter's #9313 note is a stacked PR on #9312, not cited

leads.summary: The new orientation rule silently overrides explicitly selected non-theme media
leads.consequence: The input is not restricted to theme backgrounds. `omarchy theme bg set /home/me/Pictures/portrait/photo.png` resolves the explicit path and passes it into the shell; on a landscape output, oriented() strips the last /portrait/, displaying /home/me/Pictures/photo.png when that other file exists, even though the symlink and lock screen still reference the selected photo. Conversely any external path with a sibling portrait directory is replaced on portrait screens, including video files. Bound automatic variant selection to theme files or make it opt-in for arbitrary user paths.
leads.triage: already in Opus final (F1 portrait-folder trigger)

leads.summary: Remembered load failures never expire on repair or later theme swaps
leads.consequence: After a portrait twin fails once for a canonical path, orientFailedFor holds that path for the lifetime of the panel. Installing/replacing a twin, using bg-set on that same path, refreshing an unchanged theme or rotating back to portrait keeps returning the plain path: no code resets the marker or retries the twin. Both ordinary bg-set (`finalPath === currentBackground` returns) and forced themeTransition (`displayedBackground` can become the same path) leave the marker unchanged. Clear/re-evaluate failures on reload, theme changes and user retries, and key failure to the actual candidate URL/version.
leads.triage: already in Opus final (minor: single remembered failure); not published

leads.summary: The lock screen still displays the plain image on a portrait monitor
leads.consequence: Desktop base/old/incoming frames now route through panel.oriented(), but LockView is the other caller of BackgroundMedia and binds the unmodified root.backgroundPath from lock Service. When locked, a portrait desktop showing its twin switches to the plain image; the requested portrait variant is not presented on the lock screen. If parity with the desktop is intended, apply the same screen-specific selection and fallback there, with its own versioned Image path.
leads.triage: already in Opus final (minor: lock screen); PR does not claim it; not published

leads.summary: The added test passes even when the fallback callback is disabled
leads.consequence: The tests only check that the frame path expressions exist, that a failed property exists, and the pure oriented() helper for a supplied fake failure marker. They never exercise onFailedChanged setting that marker. A plausible mutant replacing only the callback condition `if (failed && ...)` with `if (false && ...)` returned exit 0 with all eight assertions green, as did the head under LC_ALL=C. Add an assertion or QML fixture that drives Image.Error, verifies base path switches to the plain source, and also tests incomingFrame fallback.
leads.triage: already in Opus final (F4); published as optional test improvement

leads.summary: No user-facing theme instructions describe how to ship the portrait twin
leads.consequence: Theme authors are instructed to put backgrounds directly in backgrounds/, with no mention of backgrounds/portrait/<exact same filename>, which is necessary to opt in to this feature. Document the convention, the missing-file and video behavior, and whether user-added folders work so authors do not have to reverse-engineer the shell plugin.
leads.triage: already in Opus final (minor: no docs); not published

## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Outcome:** On all-portrait setups, wallpaper changes in themes without twins and image theme switches stall.

### Transition frames have no missing-twin fallback

The transition frames use `oriented()` with no fallback, and the reveal waits for `incomingFrame` to be Ready. When every output is portrait, changes in themes without `portrait/` files never reveal, and image theme switches always stall: the snapshot from `omarchy-theme-set` maps to `.../background-transitions/portrait/next-<pid>.<ext>`. **Impact:** the old wallpaper stays (the merge-base completes); mixed setups briefly show no image on the portrait screen; files in any `portrait` folder are rewritten on landscape screens.

**Suggested change:** Resolve the twin from the durable path, check once per panel that it exists before any frame binds to it, and only rewrite paths inside a `backgrounds` folder.

<details><summary>Reproducer (fails at 0b551cdc)</summary>

## 1. Test in the style of `test/shell.d/background-test.sh`

Save as `test/shell.d/portrait-twin-repro-test.sh` and run `bash test/shell.d/portrait-twin-repro-test.sh`. Blocks 1 and 2 belong to this finding; block 3 is the video finding.

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# Reproducer for omacom/omarchy#11534, in the style of test/shell.d/background-test.sh.
# Drop into test/shell.d/ next to background-test.sh. Each block reports on its own.
source "$(dirname "$0")/base-test.sh"

test_tmp=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$test_tmp"' EXIT
status=0

# The snapshot omarchy-theme-set hands to `background themeTransition` as the incoming path.
source <(awk '/^(is_video_path|snapshot_background_path)\(\) \{/ { c=1 } c { print } c && /^}$/ { c=0 }' "$ROOT/bin/omarchy-theme-set")
BACKGROUND_TRANSITION_CACHE="$test_tmp/cache/omarchy/background-transitions"
mkdir -p "$test_tmp/theme/backgrounds/portrait" "$test_tmp/Pictures/portrait"
printf 'plain\n' >"$test_tmp/theme/backgrounds/1-moonrise.png"
printf 'twin\n' >"$test_tmp/theme/backgrounds/portrait/1-moonrise.png"
printf 'photo\n' >"$test_tmp/Pictures/portrait/beach.png"
export SNAPSHOT=$(snapshot_background_path "$test_tmp/theme/backgrounds/1-moonrise.png" next)
export TEST_TMP="$test_tmp"

prelude='
const fs = require("fs")
const backgroundQml = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, "shell/plugins/background/Background.qml"), "utf8")
const fn = backgroundQml.match(/function oriented\(path\) \{[\s\S]*?\n      \}/)[0]
const oriented = (screen, orientFailedFor, p) => new Function("panel", "orientFailedFor", "path", `${fn.replace("function oriented(path)", "const oriented = (path) =>")}; return oriented(path)`)({ screen }, orientFailedFor, p)
const portrait = { width: 1440, height: 2560 }
const landscape = { width: 3840, height: 2160 }
'

run_node_test <<JS || status=1
$prelude
// A theme switch reveals the snapshot, not the theme file. The portrait lookup
// points into the snapshot cache, where no portrait/ folder is ever created.
const looked = oriented(portrait, '', process.env.SNAPSHOT)
assert(fs.existsSync(looked), 'a theme switch gives a portrait screen an incoming frame that exists', 'snapshot: ' + process.env.SNAPSHOT + '\nportrait lookup: ' + looked)
JS

run_node_test <<JS || status=1
$prelude
// A wallpaper that lives in any folder named "portrait" is rewritten on a
// landscape screen to a sibling that need not exist.
const wallpaper = path.join(process.env.TEST_TMP, 'Pictures/portrait/beach.png')
const looked = oriented(landscape, '', wallpaper)
assert(fs.existsSync(looked), 'a landscape screen keeps a wallpaper whose folder happens to be named portrait', 'wallpaper: ' + wallpaper + '\nlandscape lookup: ' + looked)
JS

run_node_test <<JS || status=1
$prelude
// Videos take the same lookup, but the video player never reports failed, so a
// missing twin is never replaced by the linked file.
const videoQml = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'shell/Ui/BackgroundVideo.qml'), 'utf8')
const clip = '/theme/backgrounds/3-clip.mp4'
assert(oriented(portrait, '', clip) === clip || /property bool failed/.test(videoQml), 'a video wallpaper on a portrait screen can fall back when it has no twin', 'portrait lookup: ' + oriented(portrait, '', clip) + '\nBackgroundVideo.qml declares failed: ' + /property bool failed/.test(videoQml))
JS

exit $status
```

**Video wallpapers without a portrait twin get no fallback on a portrait screen (reviewed head only).** `oriented()` also rewrites `.mp4` paths, and `BackgroundVideo.qml` has no `failed` property, so `BackgroundMedia.failed` stays false and the player stays on the missing `portrait/<name>.mp4`. **Impact:** a portrait output keeps trying to open a file that does not exist instead of the linked video. On the current `quattro`, OWE draws videos, so a rebase removes this path.

**Suggested change:** Skip video paths in `oriented()`.

# Reproducer: video wallpapers on a portrait output get no fallback (reviewed head 0b551cdc)

## 1. Test in the style of `test/shell.d/background-test.sh`

```bash
run_node_test <<JS || status=1
$prelude

const clip = '/theme/backgrounds/3-clip.mp4'
assert(oriented(portrait, '', clip) === clip || /property bool failed/.test(videoQml), 'a video wallpaper on a portrait screen can fall back when it has no twin', 'portrait lookup: ' + oriented(portrait, '', clip) + '\nBackgroundVideo.qml declares failed: ' + /property bool failed/.test(videoQml))
JS
```

## 2. What the PR's BackgroundMedia does with it

Same offscreen `qml6` harness as the transition-stall reproducer (the PR's Background.qml, BackgroundMedia.qml and BackgroundVideo.qml with stub Quickshell types; Qt Multimedia's FFmpeg backend loads inside the sandbox). One portrait output, `setBackground(<theme>/backgrounds/3-gamma.mp4)`, state 3.3 s later. Actual output:

The base frame's item and `failed` flag at both snapshots (actual output):

`[None]` in the first block means the base frame holds the video player rather than an Image; `failed=None` means the merge-base has no `failed` property. The head keeps the player on the missing `portrait/3-gamma.mp4` for the whole run: `BackgroundVideo.qml` has no `failed` property, so `BackgroundMedia.failed` (`current.failed === true`) stays false and `onFailedChanged` never switches back to the linked file. The merge-base player gets the linked path. (The harness's `.mp4` is not a real video, so the merge-base player then reports invalid data; the point is the path each side opens.)

**Rebase needed.** A trial three-way merge onto `quattro` 8b4eae66 gives 4 conflict hunks in `Background.qml` and 1 in `BackgroundMedia.qml`. `quattro` now gates every frame on a decode size probed per path (`decodeSize(path)`, root-level paths only), so a rebased `oriented()` also needs to probe twin paths, and the new `prepare` frame loads a snapshot path like the case above. Open PRs #10249, #11451 and #9312 implement the same feature differently.

**Suggested change:** When rebasing, probe and prune decode sizes for twin paths as well.
